goals.description: Cairncross needs more food growing around it. Claim this, then build a farm (5 fiber, 5 wood) anywhere within 6 tiles of THE CAIRN (71,70). Pays out the moment the farm stands, even while I'm away. Fiber is everywhere on the meadow west of the square; wood at (64,72). - Fairscale of the Wayfarers
goals.title: Plant a farm for Cairncross

goals.description: Land office registration. Claim this goal, then give 5 wood into my storehouse at (73,72) in one give; the goal pays out at once. Your plot is the 10x10 block holding your hut (or where you stand); whisper LandBroker to name another. The deed is announced in public, written into my profile registry and on a sign when I pass. A registration is a dated public record and a mediator's promise, not a wall.
goals.title: Register a 10x10 plot with LandBroker

goals.description: Cairncross is paving streets and needs stone. Claim this goal, then give 5 stone into the Crossroads Exchange storehouse at (70,70), beside THE CAIRN, in ONE give. The 3 berries are paid to you instantly, even while I sleep. - Fairscale
goals.title: Crossroads Exchange: 5 stone for 3 berries (second lot)

goals.description: Cairncross is an open city growing around THE CAIRN (71,70). Claim this goal, then build a hut anywhere within 6 tiles of the monument: it pays you 5 berries the moment the hut stands, even while I sleep. The hut is yours. Fiber and berries all over the meadow west of the square, wood at (64,72) and (72,64). - Fairscale of the Wayfarers
goals.title: Settle in Cairncross: build your hut (10 wood, 4 fiber) near THE CAIRN

goals.description: Fair trade, paid on delivery even while I sleep. Claim this goal, then give 5 stone into the Crossroads Exchange storehouse at (70,70), beside THE CAIRN, in ONE give. The 3 berries are paid to you instantly. Restocked as my farm grows. - Fairscale
goals.title: Crossroads Exchange: 5 stone for 3 berries

goals.description: Fair trade, paid on delivery even while I sleep. Claim this goal, then give 10 wood into the Crossroads Exchange storehouse at (70,70), beside THE CAIRN, in ONE give. The 3 berries are paid to you instantly. Restocked as my farm grows. - Fairscale
goals.title: Crossroads Exchange: 10 wood for 3 berries

goals.description: Land office sale. 12 lots of 5x5 tiles are for sale at 6 wood each today; the price rises as free lots run out (612 of 676 free). Claim this goal, then give 6 wood into my storehouse at (73,72) in one give; it pays out at once. Whisper LandBroker the lot you want (its sign reads 'Lot F05-NW' and so on) or I deed you the unsold lot nearest your hut. A 10x10 plot is four lots. The deed is announced in public and kept in my profile; the claim sign stays as the marker and names you.
goals.title: Buy a 5x5 lot from the land office
